subject: Sequencing invoices and PO windows for Q3 bookings — action items
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: finance@acme-corp.com, procurement@acme-corp.com
Cc: karthik.iyer@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Sequencing invoices and PO windows for Q3 bookings — action items

Hi Olivia / Acme team,

Thanks again for the productive call this morning. To align on internal forecasting and ensure the Q3 bookings get recognized cleanly, we need to lock the invoicing windows and PO sequencing before the end of May. High level ask: can you confirm whether Acme can accept the following flow?

- Send initial PO (covering license seats + setup) by 5/28
- Redwood issues first invoice upon PO receipt with partial fulfillment note (services: 25%)
- Final PO amendment for additional seats by 6/30; Redwood invoices remainder by 7/05 to meet July recognition cutover

I've attached a proposed timeline (Acme_PO_timeline.xlsx) and our internal billing playbook snippet for reference. If Acme requires single-invoice recognition instead of a split invoice we need that decision by 5/24 to adjust our revenue cutover plan.

Next steps for us:
1) Acme confirms preferred invoicing cadence and whether they can provision a PO in two parts.
2) Redwood finance (cc'd) will prepare the invoice templates and a note for bookings ops explaining the partial-fulfillment treatment.
3) If accepted, we circulate the DocuSign PO link and target signature by 6/01.

Olivia — can you confirm feasibility this week?

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Account Director | Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0192
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Acme_PO_timeline.xlsx

Subject: Re: Sequencing invoices and PO windows for Q3 bookings — action items

Vanessa — thanks for the summary. Quick clarifying questions from procurement:
1) If Acme issues a two-part PO, can Redwood consolidate into one invoice on your side if we request it?
2) What exact invoice cutoff will your revenue ops need to include the full value in July recognition (date/timezone)?

We typically prefer a single PO per contract but can do an amendment route. We need to validate with our AP team whether they will process a split invoice without delaying payment. I can loop AP if you provide the invoice sample language we intend to use.

Also — who at Redwood will be the signatory contact on the DocuSign?

Olivia Park

procurement@acme-corp.com

Team — some points from revenue/finance perspective:
- Recognition rule: partial invoicing is fine provided the SOW/contract language clearly ties the two invoices to one deal and the service delivery milestones are documented.
- Cutoff we should target: any invoice dated on or before 2026-07-05 (PST) will be considered for July bookings recognition given our monthly close.
- If Acme cannot accept a split invoicing approach, we need a signed single PO and invoice by 2026-06-25 to make the July recognition window (allows for AP processing time).

Action items for this thread:
1) Vanessa — share invoice sample language + payment terms we plan to put on the first invoice.
2) Marissa — prep a short note to bookings ops that explains partial-fulfillment tagging so they can adjust the ARR/booking entry.
3) I'll draft the revenue ops note on cutoffs and send to finance@redwood.ai for confirmation.

Karthik
Director, Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Olivia Park <olivia.park@acme-corp.com>, finance@acme-corp.com
Cc: karthik.iyer@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 19 May 2026 08:37:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Sequencing invoices and PO windows for Q3 bookings — action items

Olivia — thanks, answers inline below and attached the invoice template and billing playbook for Acme's AP team.

1) Consolidation: Redwood can accept a single consolidated invoice if Acme requests it, but our recommended path for predictable recognition is a two-step invoicing flow (initial invoice that triggers partial fulfillment + final invoice after amendment). This avoids delaying the go-live while capturing committed revenue.

2) Cutoff: Redwood's revenue ops will accept invoices dated through 2026-07-05 23:59 PST for July recognition. Please note our month-end processing requires payment confirmation within 10 business days for bookings to remain in the month; otherwise we may need to shift recognition to August.

3) DocuSign signatory: I'll be the Redwood signatory on the DocuSign. Expect the DocuSign link after PO confirmation.

Proposed first-invoice language (excerpt):
- "This invoice covers initial license subscription fees and onboarding services representing 25% of the total contract value. Remaining value to be invoiced upon PO amendment/acceptance as described in Section 3 of the Master Services Schedule."

Next steps:
- Olivia to confirm that AP will accept split-invoice or formally request single invoice by 5/24.
- Once confirmed, we send the DocuSign PO (target sign by 6/01).

Attaching: Redwood_Billing_Playbook_v2.pdf (short excerpt for AP) and Acme_PO_timeline.xlsx

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Account Director | Redwood Inference

Attachments: Redwood_Billing_Playbook_v2.pdf, Acme_PO_timeline.xlsx
From: Olivia Park <olivia.park@acme-corp.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, karthik.iyer@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 20 May 2026 15:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Sequencing invoices and PO windows for Q3 bookings — action items

Vanessa / team — spoke with AP and procurement. Acme can proceed with the two-stage PO approach as long as the PO clearly references the amendment flow and the invoice language indicates "partial fulfillment." AP will process the first invoice once the initial PO arrives and will release payment within their standard 8–10 business days.

We have a small ask: please include the PO number in the invoice header and add a one-line note that the remaining value will be processed under PO amendment #<tbd>.

I'll approve the DocuSign once I have the PO number and the invoice sample language in the DocuSign body. Expect confirmation of PO issuance by 5/28.

Thanks,
Olivia Park
Senior Procurement Specialist, Acme Corp
